title: Air Horn
blurb: The air horn — the official sound of hype since the DJ era, honking over every drop, win, and questionable achievement. This is a clean synthesized blast with the brassy stacked-harmonic character of the real thing, minus anyone else's recording. Spam it responsibly (or don't): stream wins, goal celebrations, and moments that absolutely did not deserve an air horn. Free MP3 download.
origin: Original harmonic-stack synthesis in the style of the classic DJ air horn.
